primary_observation.evidence_section: Methods / Identifying amyloid-associated gene expression signatures in human and mouse
primary_observation.use_summary: Used monocle3 1.3.1 fit_models GLMs to relate spatial gene expression to amyloid Getis-Ord Gi* hotspot scores, adjusting for biological sample and UMI count; followed significant Wald-test results with positive Pearson-correlation filtering.
primary_observation.evidence_locator: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11631771/ (section: Methods / Identifying amyloid-associated gene expression signatures in human and mouse)
primary_observation.implementation_scope_note: This is gene-wise GLM inference, not Monocle pseudotime. The model family, exact formula/encoding, normalization and full testing family are unstated. Human grey-matter filtering, mouse regional fits, separate stains and subsequent Pearson filtering remain explicit upstream/downstream steps. The attempted original 1.3.1 runtime is skipped because grr does not compile under R 4.6.1; a current 1.4.27 synthetic quasipoisson probe is not a silent version/family substitution.

findings: Human spatial notebook lines776-940 uses prepared data-slot expression, separate selected grey-matter populations, amyloid Gi score, Sample and nCount_Spatial additive covariates, omitted family/cleaning arguments and coefficient-table q filtering.
Human notebook lines1120-1180 filters the original supplied expression by positive Hmisc Pearson correlation; no adjusted coefficient-sign or Pearson-p cutoff is added.
Mouse notebook lines654-770 prepares separate region/cluster and amyloid populations and uses uppercase SAMPLE with nCount_Spatial. These are distinct declared model populations.
The snRNA notebook lines764-818 uses a separate expression-proportion filter and Amylo_Area, Sample and nCount_RNA formula; it is not the spatial-model population.

Saved RDS inputs, active assay/transformation, executed notebook state and paper source commit remain unresolved. The historical R4.6.1 attempt remains skipped; the new private R4.3.3 original1.3.1 model runtime passes separate synthetic controls.
